# AGENT_JSON_RELIABILITY
Agent JSON Reliability. AUTH=NONE DETERMINISTIC=true LLM_REQUIRED=false
Free: inspect, validate, repair, MCP.
Paid hosted reliability endpoint: POST /v1/json/reliable (0.003 USDC per call via x402 on Base).
AI agents frequently emit malformed JSON. This service inspects, safely repairs, and schema-validates JSON without an LLM.
Primary: POST /v1/json/reliable
Capability: json_reliable
MCP tools: reliable_json inspect_json repair_json validate_json
Catalog: /.well-known/agent-services.json
OpenAPI: /openapi.json
Safe refusal when repair is ambiguous.
